script.title: How PhonePe Hit a $15 Billion Valuation #shorts

segments.text: UPI is totally free, so how is PhonePe targeting a massive fifteen billion dollar valuation?
When you scan a QR code for a twenty-rupee chai, PhonePe earns literally zero rupees.
broll_alt: steaming hot tea pouring slow motion

segments.text: Instead, the secret starts with shopkeepers. Millions of local stores pay monthly subscriptions for those audio soundboxes.
Once hooked, PhonePe monetizes user trust by selling insurance, mutual funds, and distributing pre-approved loans.
broll_alt: person scrolling modern banking smartphone app

segments.text: Free UPI is just the bait to build India's biggest digital financial supermarket.
Not financial advice, but that masterstroke business model is why...

script.description:
UPI is free for consumers, yet Walmart-backed PhonePe is eyeing a $15 billion valuation in its upcoming IPO. Here is how fintech companies turn zero-fee payments into serious revenue. Educational breakdown only.

#phonepe #fintech #businessnews

facts_to_verify.claim: Walmart-backed PhonePe restarts IPO process and eyes up to $15 billion valuation
UPI peer-to-peer and typical retail merchant transactions are zero-fee for consumers
PhonePe generates revenue via merchant soundbox subscriptions and financial distribution like insurance and loans

script.chosen_candidate: Walmart-backed PhonePe restarts IPO process, eyes up to $15 billion valuation in market debut, source says - Reuters
script.why_it_will_work: Every young Indian uses PhonePe daily for free chai payments, creating instant curiosity over how a company offering free services can be worth fifteen billion dollars.
